# Gozzy Nwogbo — gozzynwogbo.com

> Management consultant and technology builder. Toronto, Canada. Nigerian.

## About

Gozzy Nwogbo applies McKinsey-style strategic frameworks to hands-on platform
development across Nigeria's fintech, healthcare, and defense sectors. He holds
an MSc in Digital Management from Ivey Business School and a BBA in Information
Systems from Boston University.

## Projects

- [Nigerian Digital Banking Platform](/projects/nigerian-fintech-platform): Mobile-first digital banking for unbanked Nigerians. 82% onboarding rate, 10,000+ monthly transactions.
- [Healthcare Workflow Automation](/projects/healthcare-workflow): AI-powered clinical workflow system. 35% efficiency gain across 3 pilot clinics.
- [Defense Technology Platform](/projects/defense-tech): Secure offline-first communications for Nigerian defense operations. Architecture complete, MVP in development.

## Expertise

Consulting: case methodology, market sizing, business model design, strategic planning
Technology: Python, FastAPI, React, React Native, Three.js, LangChain, PostgreSQL, n8n
Domain: Nigerian fintech (NIBSS, BVN), healthcare workflow, defense logistics, AI automation
